cds.sub.en: Real people only: robots and the team's own accounts are left out. Days are Pacific time.
cds.sub.zh: 只统计真人：机器人和团队自己的账号都已剔除。日期按美国太平洋时间。

cds.readAt.zh: {time} 从 crazydramas.com 读取（缓存 5 分钟）。

cds.readAtFake.en: Demo numbers from the fixture crazydramas, invented, not measured.
cds.readAtFake.zh: 演示数据，来自模拟的 crazydramas，是编造的，不是实测。

cds.failed.en: Could not read the stats from crazydramas: {error}
cds.failed.zh: 无法从 crazydramas 读取数据：{error}

cds.failed.readOff.en: Studio may not read crazydramas' stats here: {error}
cds.failed.readOff.zh: 这里不能读取 crazydramas 的数据：{error}

cds.aud.sub.en: People who pressed play on any episode. Each day counts a person once; the week and the month count each person once too.
cds.aud.sub.zh: 按下播放的人（任意分集）。每天每人只算一次；本周、本月也是每人只算一次。

cds.aud.chartDesc.en: Column chart of people who pressed play each day, {from} to {to}.
cds.aud.chartDesc.zh: 每天按下播放的人数柱状图，{from} 至 {to}。

cds.aud.tip.en: {day}: {watchers} watching, {visitors} opened a page, {fresh} for the first time
cds.aud.tip.zh: {day}：{watchers} 人观看，{visitors} 人打开页面，{fresh} 人第一次

cds.money.sub.en: Live payments made in this period (test payments left out).
cds.money.sub.zh: 这段时间内的真实付款（不含测试付款）。

cds.series.sub.en: People who first opened each series in this period, and what they did after. Every percentage is of the people who opened it.
cds.series.sub.zh: 这段时间内第一次打开该剧的人，以及他们之后做了什么。所有百分比都以“打开”的人数为基数。

cds.series.none.en: Nobody opened these in this period: {titles}.
cds.series.none.zh: 这段时间内没有人打开：{titles}。

cds.series.robots.en: {n} robot visits left out of this table.
cds.series.robots.zh: 本表剔除了 {n} 次机器人访问。

cds.defs.person.en: A person is one phone or browser. The same person on two phones counts twice.
cds.defs.person.zh: 一个人 = 一部手机或一个浏览器。同一个人用两部手机会算两次。

cds.defs.robots.en: Robots are automated visits, mostly ad networks' crawlers. They “see” many locked episodes in the same second, or jump straight to the last episode's unlock screen without playing anything, or name themselves as crawlers. They are left out of every number: {n} in the last 120 days.
cds.defs.robots.zh: 机器人是自动访问，大多是广告平台的爬虫：它们在同一秒内“看到”很多个锁定的分集，或者什么都没播放就直接跳到最后一集的解锁界面，或者自称爬虫。所有数字都剔除了它们：近 120 天共 {n} 个。

cds.defs.played.en: Played ep 1: pressed play on episode 1. Finished ep 1: watched it to the end.
cds.defs.played.zh: 播放第 1 集：按下了第 1 集的播放。看完第 1 集：看到了结尾。

cds.defs.watched.en: Watched ep 2 / ep 3: watched at least a quarter of that episode. A swipe that flicks past it does not count.
cds.defs.watched.zh: 观看第 2 / 3 集：至少看了该集的四分之一。一划而过不算。

cds.defs.paywall.en: Reached paywall: saw the unlock screen. Tapped Unlock: went on to the payment page. Paid: a live payment for the series.
cds.defs.paywall.zh: 到达付费墙：看到了解锁界面。点击解锁：进入了付款页面。付费：为该剧真实付款。

cds.defs.test.en: Test series (archived on crazydramas) and test payments are left out.
cds.defs.test.zh: 测试剧集（在 crazydramas 上已归档）和测试付款都不计入。

cds.d.meta.en: {free} free episodes of {count} · episode 1 is {len} long
cds.d.meta.zh: 共 {count} 集，前 {free} 集免费 · 第 1 集时长 {len}

cds.d.metaNoLen.zh: 共 {count} 集，前 {free} 集免费

cds.d.notFound.zh: crazydramas 上没有剧集“{slug}”的数据。

cds.d.nobody.en: Nobody opened this series in this period.
cds.d.nobody.zh: 这段时间内没有人打开这部剧。

cds.path.sub.en: People who first opened the series in this period. Each bar is a share of them.
cds.path.sub.zh: 这段时间内第一次打开这部剧的人。每一条都是占他们的比例。

cds.path.played.zh: 按下了第 1 集的播放

cds.path.ep2.en: Of the {finished} who finished episode 1, {n} ({share}) watched episode 2.
cds.path.ep2.zh: 看完第 1 集的 {finished} 人中，{n} 人（{share}）观看了第 2 集。

cds.ep1.title.zh: 第 1 集：观众停留多久

cds.ep1.sub.en: Of the people who pressed play on episode 1, the share still watching at each point. Measured in 15-second steps.
cds.ep1.sub.zh: 按下第 1 集播放的人中，每个时间点仍在观看的比例。以 15 秒为单位测量。

cds.ep1.halfAt.zh: 到 {at} 时一半的人已离开。

cds.ep1.halfStay.en: More than half watched to the end.
cds.ep1.halfStay.zh: 一半以上的人看到了结尾。

cds.ep1.none.en: Nobody pressed play on episode 1 in this period.
cds.ep1.none.zh: 这段时间内没有人播放第 1 集。

cds.ep1.chart.zh: 仍在观看第 1 集的比例

cds.ep1.chartDesc.en: Line chart of the share of {n} people still watching episode 1 at each point.
cds.ep1.chartDesc.zh: {n} 人中每个时间点仍在观看第 1 集的比例折线图。

cds.eps.sub.en: People who started each episode, and how many of them watched at least a quarter of it. The line marks the paywall.
cds.eps.sub.zh: 每一集开始播放的人数，以及其中至少看了四分之一的人数。竖线是付费墙的位置。

cds.eps.started.zh: 开始播放（包括一划而过）

cds.eps.hidden.en: Episodes after {n}: nobody has started them yet.
cds.eps.hidden.zh: 第 {n} 集之后：还没有人开始播放。

cds.eps.chartDesc.en: Column chart of people who started each episode and who watched at least a quarter of it, episodes 1 to {n}.
cds.eps.chartDesc.zh: 第 1 至 {n} 集，每集开始播放和至少看了四分之一的人数柱状图。

cds.eps.tip.en: Episode {n}: {started} started, {watched} watched a quarter or more
cds.eps.tip.zh: 第 {n} 集：{started} 人开始播放，{watched} 人至少看了四分之一

cds.pay.none.en: Nobody reached the unlock screen in this period.
cds.pay.none.zh: 这段时间内没有人到达解锁界面。

cds.pay.watched.en: {n} got there after watching the episode before it.
cds.pay.watched.zh: {n} 人是看完前一集后到达的。

cds.pay.skipped.en: {n} swiped past the free episodes, or picked a locked one from the episode list, without watching the one before.
cds.pay.skipped.zh: {n} 人没看前一集：一路划过免费分集，或在分集列表里直接点了锁定的一集。

cds.pay.after.en: {checkouts} tapped Unlock and {buyers} paid, {revenue} in all (All-Access renewals included).
cds.pay.after.zh: {checkouts} 人点击了解锁，{buyers} 人付费，合计 {revenue}（含 All-Access 续费）。

cds.d.robots.en: {n} robot visits to this series left out.
cds.d.robots.zh: 剔除了这部剧的 {n} 次机器人访问。

cds.defs.team.en: The team's own accounts (the emails under “Team accounts left out”) are left out too, with the phones they use and the payments they made.
cds.defs.team.zh: 团队自己的账号（“剔除的团队账号”里的邮箱）也会剔除，包括它们使用的手机和付款。

mcd.perFinisher.zh: 每位看完第 1 集的成本

mcd.none.en: On CrazyDramas: nobody from this ad yet.
mcd.none.zh: 在 CrazyDramas 上：这条广告还没有带来观众。

cds.ads.sub.en: Each ad's whole life: what TikTok charged and counted (from Studio's launches), and the real people it brought to CrazyDramas and what they did. Judge an ad by what it costs per episode 1 finisher, not per click.
cds.ads.sub.zh: 每条广告从上线至今：TikTok 的花费和点击（来自 Studio 的投放），以及它带到 CrazyDramas 的真人和他们的行为。评判广告看“每位看完第 1 集的成本”，而不是每次点击的价格。

cds.ads.foot.en: Visitors are real people who opened the series from the ad (one per phone or browser, robots and the team left out); the percentage under them is of the ad's clicks, the others are of its visitors. Visitors are fewer than clicks: some taps never load the page, one person can click twice, visitors from TikTok's stored copy are in their own row, and TikTok's iPhone browser recorded few visits until Sep 24, 6 pm.
cds.ads.foot.zh: 访客是通过广告打开这部剧的真人（每部手机或浏览器算一人，机器人和团队已剔除）；访客下面的百分比以广告点击数为基数，其他列以访客数为基数。访客少于点击：有些点击没有打开页面，同一个人可能点击两次，来自 TikTok 缓存副本的访客单独一行，而且 9 月 24 日下午 6 点之前 TikTok 的 iPhone 浏览器记录到的访问很少。

cds.ads.none.en: No ad has sent anyone yet.

cds.ads.notStudio.zh: 非 Studio 投放的广告

cds.ads.storedCopy.zh: TikTok 广告（具体哪条未知）

cds.ads.storedCopySub.en: TikTok showed its stored copy of the page and the ad's id was lost (fixed Sep 24, 8:26 pm)
cds.ads.storedCopySub.zh: TikTok 显示了页面的缓存副本，广告编号丢失（9 月 24 日晚 8:26 已修复）

cds.ads.noAdSub.en: Opened directly, from a shared link or from a TikTok post
cds.ads.noAdSub.zh: 直接打开、通过分享链接或 TikTok 帖子进入

cds.ads.best.zh: 看完第 1 集成本最低

cds.team.sub.en: Left out of every number above: {people} phones or browsers, {payments} payments ({revenue}).
cds.team.sub.zh: 以上所有数字都已剔除：{people} 部手机或浏览器，{payments} 笔付款（{revenue}）。

cds.team.label.en: The emails the team watches and buys with on CrazyDramas, one per line
cds.team.label.zh: 团队在 CrazyDramas 上观看和购买所用的邮箱，每行一个

cds.team.saved.en: Saved. The numbers above now leave these accounts out.
cds.team.saved.zh: 已保存。上面的数字已剔除这些账号。

cds.team.empty.en: No team accounts yet. An administrator adds them here.
cds.team.empty.zh: 还没有团队账号，由管理员在这里添加。

cds.team.updated.zh: 最后由 {by} 于 {at} 修改。

cds.path.returned.en: {n} ({share}) came back to the series on a later day.
cds.path.returned.zh: {n} 人（{share}）在之后的某天回来看了这部剧。

cds.path.errors.en: {n} had a video fail to play.

cds.before.sub.en: The people who opened the series but never saw an episode play, and on which phones.
cds.before.sub.zh: 打开了这部剧、却从没看到任何一集开始播放的人，以及他们用的手机。

cds.before.neverStarted.zh: {n} 人（{share}）从没有任何一集开始播放。

cds.before.waited.en: {n} of them were seen leaving, after {avg} s on average.
cds.before.waited.zh: 其中 {n} 人被记录到离开，平均停留 {avg} 秒。

cds.before.noEvents.en: {n} ({share}) more landed and then recorded nothing at all. Most are TikTok's iPhone browser before Sep 24, 6 pm, which dropped our events: we don't know whether they watched.
cds.before.noEvents.zh: 另有 {n} 人（{share}）打开页面后没有任何记录。大多来自 9 月 24 日下午 6 点之前 TikTok 的 iPhone 浏览器，它丢失了我们的事件：无法知道他们是否观看。

cds.ep1.sound.en: {on} of {known} ({share}) had sound on (recorded since Sep 25).
cds.ep1.sound.zh: {known} 人中有 {on} 人（{share}）开着声音（9 月 25 日起记录）。

cds.ep1.soundUnknown.en: Sound on or off is recorded from Sep 25; the player starts with sound on since then.
cds.ep1.soundUnknown.zh: 声音开关从 9 月 25 日起记录；从那时起播放器默认开启声音。

cds.survey.sub.en: The one-tap questions in the player, each shown at most once per visit: when someone pauses episode 1 early, and when someone closes the unlock screen.
cds.survey.sub.zh: 播放器里的一键问题，每次访问最多出现一次：有人提前暂停第 1 集时，以及有人关闭解锁界面时。

cds.survey.counts.zh: 展示给 {shown} 人，{answered} 人回答。

cds.survey.notYet.en: Not shown to anyone yet (asked since Sep 25).
cds.survey.notYet.zh: 还没有展示给任何人（9 月 25 日起询问）。

cds.survey.ep1_stop.q.en: Paused episode 1: why did you stop?
cds.survey.ep1_stop.q.zh: 暂停第 1 集：为什么停下？

cds.survey.paywall_close.q.en: Closed the unlock screen: what stopped you?
cds.survey.paywall_close.q.zh: 关闭解锁界面：是什么让你没有解锁？

cds.src.sub.en: The ads that sent people to this series, over each ad's whole life, with what they cost.
cds.src.sub.zh: 把观众带到这部剧的广告（每条广告从上线至今）以及花费。

cds.ads.bestHint.en: The cheapest episode 1 finishers came from ad {id}: open its campaign to see it.
cds.ads.bestHint.zh: 看完第 1 集成本最低的是广告 {id}：展开它所在的广告系列即可看到。

cds.ads.sort.per_finisher.zh: 每位看完第 1 集成本最低

cds.ads.sort.per_ep2.zh: 每位观看第 2 集成本最低

cds.ads.sort.finished.zh: 看完第 1 集人数最多

cds.ads.sort.ep2.zh: 观看第 2 集人数最多

cds.ads.col.peopleHint.en: Real people who opened the series from this ad: one per phone or browser, robots and the team left out. Fewer than clicks: some taps never load the page, one person can click twice, and visitors from TikTok's stored copy of the page are in the “TikTok ad, which one unknown” row.
cds.ads.col.peopleHint.zh: 通过这条广告打开这部剧的真人：每部手机或浏览器算一人，机器人和团队已剔除。访客少于点击：有些点击没有打开页面，同一个人可能点击两次，来自 TikTok 页面缓存副本的访客在“TikTok 广告（具体哪条未知）”一行。

cds.survey.allTitle.zh: 观众为什么停下（全部剧集）

cds.survey.allSub.en: The player's two one-tap questions (asked since Sep 25), every series together in this period. Each series' own page has its answers too.
cds.survey.allSub.zh: 播放器里的两个一键问题（9 月 25 日起询问），这段时间内所有剧集合计。每部剧自己的页面也有它的回答。
